rules: One entry per vocabulary style or extra; the 15 genres themselves are level 1 and not listed.
parent: null for level 2 (umbrella or standalone style), else a level 2 key; hard cap three levels.
also_under: other level 2 keys a style could sit under; the primary parent stays in parent.
provisional: true marks an undrafted placeholder (all genres except Electronic); parent null.
discogs: true when the key is in genre_styles.json, false when it exists only in genre_extras.json.

genres: level 1 name plus lowercase synonyms; style entries may carry an optional synonyms list (carried over from ALIASES in genre_filter.py, read-only). A synonym never equals a vocabulary key, a genre name or another synonym; typos are input normalisation, not synonyms.
flavours: optional list of keys of the top-level 'flavours' block ({name, kind sound|scene, description}); a modifier alongside the tree, not a level. Only Electronic entries carry them so far.
status: optional 'approved' (Alex approved; only on entries with discogs false, because Discogs outranks his approval) or 'question' (under question, any entry); absent means unreviewed.
display: optional display name of a style (default: the key); never equal, when lowercased, to another vocabulary key.

also_in_genres: optional list of other genres (level 1 names) in whose tree a level 2 entry also appears as a node, because children of those genres hang under it (disco: Electronic). A child keeps its own genre; its parent may sit in a genre listed here. also_under may point at any other entry (a level 3 target is allowed, e.g. spacesynth -> italo disco).
